review: Flag proportions in the generated board are approximate. Product tiles use the pinned SVG source.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create a premium tactile country flag tile design concept board for Bucket and Polingual. A landscape wide studio product photograph on warm ivory paper showing eight physical square collectible tiles, in two rows of four with generous spacing, all seen from the same slight overhead camera, soft northwest light, gentle contact shadows, near-front orthographic view. Each tile has a thick 6mm ivory ceramic body with bevelled 14mm radius corners and a deeply tactile narrow regional craft-inspired surround; flag face at center remains a clean geometrically exact national flag in its native aspect ratio, fully visible with breathing room, no cropping. Top row: Japan flag red disk on white in a polished dark vermilion lacquer frame; France blue-white-red equal vertical tricolor in deep navy enamel frame; Italy green-white-red equal vertical tricolor in cream maiolica frame with tiny cobalt edge accents; Netherlands red-white-blue equal horizontal tricolor in a Delft-inspired cream and cobalt frame. Bottom row: Finland blue Nordic cross on white in translucent frosted glass frame; Indonesia equal red-over-white flag in warm cream wax-print-inspired dotted frame; Ghana red-yellow-green horizontal tricolor with centered black five-point star in a narrow woven geometric strip frame; Switzerland square red flag with centered white cross in a porcelain frame. Fine natural microtexture in the materials, edges catch light, flag colors saturated and true, each tile feels satisfying to hold, adult art-museum shop collectible quality with playful heft. No letters, labels, typography, logos, maps, weapons, plants, props, ornate sacred patterns, or extra icons. Frame decoration stays off the national flag artwork. Keep all eight tiles identical outer size and camera angle, every tile entirely in frame. This is a material concept study.
